title: Navy recovering non-human craft from the ocean floor

tellings.quote: crafts of non-human origin are being recovered at the bottom of our oceans all over the world by the Navy.

plain: The US Navy is said to be recovering "crafts of non-human origin" from the bottom of the oceans all over the world. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, in an episode about the two days he spent with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in Nevada. If true, it would mean such craft are being found and quietly collected at sea, not only on land.
